run_model_evaluation: run the test script to evaluate a pretrained negotiation model on the test dataset and print loss and perplexity
run_engine_forward: run Engine.forward on a batch to produce model output, hidden state, target, selection output, and selection target
create_criterion: create a Criterion instance with a word dictionary and optional bad tokens for computing loss
load_model: load a pretrained model from a file using utils.load_model for evaluation
build_word_corpus: build a WordCorpus from a data directory with a frequency cutoff and generate a test dataset with batching
